resolutions.resolves: BASE_RAM = 5, the per turn RAM budget before any night upgrade.
MAX_RAM = 9, the ceiling a night RAM pick can raise ramPerTurn to.
carryCap is set to 2 for the player's SideEcon when a duel is generated, the cap on unspent RAM carried into the next turn.
inReach walks the working reach from built ground through unbuilt junctions and returns whether idx is reachable; it is only reached at all for a junction that is not built.

resolutions.claimed: always legal to rotate regardless of reach
resolutions.resolves: canRotate returns true for a built junction before it ever calls inReach (if (c.built) return true;), so built ground is exempt from the reach check entirely.
cascadeRam returns 0 when lit < 3, so three built nodes in one settle is the first count that pays banked RAM.
surgeTierOf returns surge at lit >= 6; settleBoard uses that tier to shatter every enemy lock on the board.
surgeTierOf returns break at lit >= 10; settleBoard uses that tier to also destroy one armed enemy trap.
